Great all-round performance by the team. Big smiles as always. Up 2-0 at half time with strong running, tackles and communication. Kept it going in the 2nd half to come up with a deserved 5-1 win. A very proud team.

What Went Well

Passing improved and kept our shape. Stayed focused and disciplined with our positions.
